description: This file defines the BuzzFeedAPI class, a REST API endpoint for retrieving a list of buzz feed posts within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for fetching, validating parameters, and stubs for create and delete operations, primarily focusing on listing buzz posts with filtering, sorting, and pagination.
